restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r3-prefix-v1 only (partial rounds 4, 5 and 6 plus the eight fixed full rounds 0-3 and 60-63); the construction uses the first two full rounds being affine on the line of proof.md section 3 and gives no claim for other round counts.

time_log2 is the worst-case operation count of the algorithm of proof.md section 5 (one centre, K = 1, one thread, every trial charged in full, stage D charged for the normal remainder sequence and any other sequence ending the trial after a prefix of that work, root isolation capped at 16 rounds at degree at most 16 with the 120-pair failure bound), plus the offline derivation of proof.md section 6.2, counted and charged at the declared cap 1,000,000 operations = preprocessing_log2 20, inside time_log2 (one quantity). Memory is the footprint of proof.md section 7.

Cost model orchard-field-ram-v2: every field operation, load, store, control operation and random word is priced 1/C with C = 216 + 21*3 = 279; the reference permutation cost is used only as the unit and no permutation call is charged as a unit.

success_probability 0.39126 is a lower bound over the algorithm’s fresh independent uniform 256-bit random words for the fixed target, derived from the score-critical premise H-ONE (q = 0.3931, proof.md section 8) minus the isolation bound (120*(1/2+2^-127)^16 = 0.0018311) and the coin-distance bound (< 2^-128). The executed instance of proof.md section 9 is a good centre and supplies one direct observation at the target depth, not a probability estimate.

Machine: a word RAM with 256-bit words under orchard-field-ram-v2; every load and store is charged (9 operations per radix-2 butterfly), transforms are radix-2 in place with twiddles formed on the fly, and the memory of proof.md section 7 is the whole footprint (single thread, no stored advice).

The certificate was produced by an independent big-integer implementation of the same line, odd part and root criterion, and is verified by the organizer reference checker; the resource bound describes the algorithm of section 5, not that implementation.

heuristics.statement: For c uniform on F_p, P(1 <= k(c) <= 16) >= 0.3931, where k(c) is the number of nonzero squares S with g_c(S) = 0 and g_c is the monic odd part of the fixed digest polynomial F of this target (degree 976,562). With one centre and the coin/isolation bounds this gives success probability at least 0.3931.
heuristics.scope: The fixed target poseidon-orchard-r3-prefix-v1, the line j = 0 of the first two rounds, the polynomial F of proof.md section 3, centres uniform on F_p. Nothing is claimed for other round counts.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the Poisson(1/2) fixed-point law of the hyperoctahedral monodromy group at two and three S-box layers (a theorem on the deployed constants in the lineage) and toy-field counts at 3 to 8 layers, to N = 9 layers at r = 3, with an allowance of 0.0003693 below 1 - e^(-1/2) = 0.3934693. The executed centre is a good centre at the target depth and is one direct observation, not a rate.
heuristics.limitations: A premise at the target depth, not a theorem; false for permutation polynomials and for decomposable F with imprimitive monodromy; one executed instance is not a probability estimate; the costs and the certificate do not depend on H-ONE (only the success probability does).
